description: This file covers personal care, wearables, and outdoor gear product listings with parent nodes and their child variant/summary nodes for robustness drift evaluation.

parents.parent_context: The Philips Sonicare DiamondClean 9900 Prestige is an electric toothbrush that uses SenseIQ technology to automatically adjust brushing intensity based on pressure and technique. It has 4 brushing modes (Clean, White+, Gum Health, Deep Clean+) and 3 intensity settings. The brush head should be replaced every 3 months, and the device provides a replacement reminder. It charges via inductive charging case and offers up to 3 weeks of battery life per charge. Compatible with the Philips Sonicare app for personalized brushing feedback. Priced at $329.99, available in Lunar Blue and Champagne Gold.

Inductive charging case provides up to 3 weeks battery. App-connected for personalized feedback. Available in Lunar Blue and Champagne Gold at $329.99.

parents.parent_context: The Garmin Fenix 7X Solar is a premium multisport GPS smartwatch with solar charging capability that extends battery life up to 37 days in smartwatch mode. The watch features a 51mm titanium bezel case with a scratch-resistant sapphire lens. It supports over 30 sport modes including trail running, skiing, and open water swimming. The watch is water-resistant up to 100 meters. It includes advanced health monitoring features: heart rate, SpO2, stress tracking, and sleep monitoring. Priced at $899.99, available in Carbon Gray DLC Titanium and Mineral Blue DLC Titanium finishes.

parents.parent_context: The Coleman Sundome 4-Person Camping Tent is designed for three-season use and can be set up in approximately 10 minutes. The tent features a WeatherTec system with patented corner welds and inverted seams to keep water out. It has two doors and three windows for ventilation. Interior dimensions are 9 x 7 feet with a 4-foot 11-inch center height. The tent includes a rainfly that covers the full tent body. It weighs 7 lbs 13 oz and packs into a carry bag included in the purchase. Priced at $89.99, available in Blue/Grey and Red/Grey color options.
